case.summary: Case CASE-005 involves two card-not-present transactions (4012170, 4012171) totaling $683.71 on card SC-03005-K949. The real-time model scored transaction 4012170 ($430.53, domestic) at 0.85 risk [EV-7bb34eac]. Transaction 4012170 originated from a new device (Linux x86_64 Chrome 96.0 with synthetic identifiers) and an anonymous proxy connection from Argentina [EV-8215d9d1, EV-a4f0f4aa]. The card showed 1 prior transaction averaging $253.18 [EV-c8da2d41] and 2 online transactions within 48 hours [EV-f46504e2]. The device profile appears in a prior confirmed fraud case [EV-c7739603], and the customer has a prior fraud case CC-4320 [EV-79340634]. The customer denies authorizing the purchases and confirms physical card possession [EV-90f23ed6]. The pattern matches 6 prior card_not_present_new_device cases [EV-7c9b91bc].
